notes.title: Update Notes for November 21
notes.content: Added gallery installation which can be accessed by pressing "g" on the first level. Gallery installation is based on a real-life exhibition at the LaVerne Krause Gallery (Eugene, OR), which ran Nov 15-18, 2021.
